bio: Elena Prévost is the fashion director of Mode & Object. She writes about how people actually get dressed — the editing, the keeping, and the case against buying more.
Nadia Okonkwo directs beauty coverage at Mode & Object. Her subject is restraint — skin, scent and the discipline of doing less, reported from the chair and the lab.
Julian Hart is the runway critic of Mode & Object. He reads collections the way others read books, and files from the front row on what a season was actually saying.
